metric_definitions.false_success_tasks: officially failed tasks that generated complete_task(status=success)
metric_definitions.invalid_api_events: environment errors matching missing/unknown API or HTTP 404
metric_definitions.max_step_tasks: tasks with max logged step or LM-call count at least 50
metric_definitions.python_error_events: environment logger messages containing an execution traceback
metric_definitions.wrong_argument_events: environment errors matching HTTP 422, validation, missing or unexpected arguments

scope: 15 seen training tasks; deterministic diagnostic, not an unseen generalization estimate

selection_rule.description: Fixed stratified selection mandated for the four-model aligned Train-15 diagnostic. It covers all five required-app combinations represented by the selected scenarios and spans 7/8-step short, 10-step medium, and 13-step long trajectories with API and prompt-complexity gradients. No task was selected after observing evaluation outputs.
selection_rule.diagnostic_scope: All selected tasks are members of the 67-task SFT/LoRA training corpus; results measure seen-train fit and must not be interpreted as held-out generalization.

intersection67.definition: train90 order filtered to SFT67 membership
